note: The game now has real music and sound: a title theme, a tavern tune, a full town theme, a dungeon drone, and a looping fields theme that follow you as you move — tavern music takes over inside the tavern and hands back to the town theme when you step out, dungeons get their own track, and every other town plays the town theme while the wilds play the fields loop. Coins now clink when gold changes hands, attacks grunt (women fighters and men soldiers each sound like themselves), opening the map has its own sound, and Ember Bolt crackles with fire. The title screen is black with green buttons, and Options on the title screen opens the same music list and sound controls as in-game: every track listed with what is playing now, music and effects on their own on/off switches and volume sliders, all saved on this device. Music starts on your first tap, because browsers block sound before that.
